title: The guard asks before a push past a reviewed head that already has a fix check
why: At 18:44 CST Nov 7 the coordinator told lane mixed-merge-resolver to add Fix lines on #1683's reviewed head. That moved the head past its review record, and the merge tool could not chain a second fix check.
note: Fix: the guard asks before a push to a lane branch whose head has a passing review record and whose PR already has a fix check, and names "stack it on a new branch" as the remedy. Repair of the incident (coordinator pick, 18:54 CST, can be undone): revert those commits on #1683 and move the lines to the stacked PR. #1871 sighting (lane process-held-end-to-end, 06:54 CST Nov 8; filed as reviewed-head-push-warns, folded here): a docs commit pushed to #1871 after its one fix check moved the head off its done record; the cost is a fresh rounds 1-3 chain. Nothing warned before the push.
